lessons.lesson: The note's phone-control advice (line 15) still assumes auto attack plus timing release; the current decision is manual by default, plus an optional auto ON/OFF toggle that starts OFF, is unlocked by an optional quest, fires basic attacks and skills, and hits monsters only. The video principles that still apply are predictable control and lighter feedback for frequent events.
lessons.quote: 기존 이동·점프와 자동 공격·타이밍 발사를 유지한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Auto is hard-blocked in three places: CombatService.luau:603 `if isManual ~= true then return end`, :809 `if isAuto == true then return end`, and :1149-1160 (SetAutoAttack remote always sets AutoAttack=false). The auto button is gone from the HUD (only Map and Menu are built, HUD.luau:1412-1418), but the TXT.AutoOn/AutoOff strings remain (HUD.luau:148-149) and the row width still reserves 3 squares (HUD.luau:2894). Monster-only branches already exist: Swing adds players only when isManual (CombatService.luau:653-657, 668-670, 684-688, 714-716), and Release skips players when isAuto (847-852, 889). The camera kick is sent only for manual hits (802).
lessons.suggestion: Server side: add a persisted AutoUnlocked flag plus a session AutoEnabled flag (OFF at start). Run a per-player auto loop that calls the existing Swing and Release paths with an auto flag, so the MP and cooldown guard (CombatService.luau:824-834) and the monster-only branches apply. Manual presses keep working while auto is ON. Auto pauses while dead or while a panel/map is open. Client side: put a toggle in the reserved third square using the existing BtnSquare and the AutoOn/AutoOff text; no new icon unless approved via Firefly. Ask the user whether auto hits should count for the goose tug (a faction contest; Config.Goose.AutoCount exists) and whether OFF resets every session.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Note line 15 (keep auto attack plus timing release) is superseded by manual combat (GDD §0-2) and then by the 2026-10-05 optional toggle. GDD.md:39 still says 'no auto attack' and needs a doc update. Do not restore charge, PERFECT or stacks.

lessons.lesson: Teach one thing at a time and tie side activities to the same goal. The new optional auto-unlock quest must not compete with or hide the first mission.
lessons.quote: 현재 단계에서 실행할 행동 하나와 그 결과를 알아볼 수 있는지 먼저 본다.
lessons.status_evidence: There is no auto-unlock quest yet: tutorialEntry builds only the Welcome, Travel, Quest and VisitBlacksmith rows (QuestService.luau:393-421). The pinned tutorial row is shown first in the collapsed and touch quest views (HUD.luau:2280-2300).
lessons.suggestion: Offer the optional quest right after faction selection, as required, but as a secondary row below the pinned first mission. Its objective should require manual play (e.g. defeat N slimes by direct attack; the user picks N), so manual combat is learned first and the reward is simply the toggle. It must never replace the pinned row on the touch one-line view, and it must stay optional.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: None, as long as it stays optional and auto stays OFF until the player enables it.

lessons.lesson: Paths and quest markers steer behaviour. After the blacksmith visit the player gets no next goal, so the hunt → reward → growth chain breaks at about minute 5.
lessons.quote: 길·버튼·퀘스트 표시가 행동을 이끈다는 논지다.
lessons.status_evidence:
The chain works up to the blacksmith: the Claimed text points there (Config.luau:951) and a beam guides to the anvil (HUD.luau:2565-2568). After that it stops:
- Once BlacksmithVisited is set (ShopService.luau:200), tutorialEntry returns nil (QuestService.luau:409-414) and the beam is cleared (HUD.luau:2559).
- The upgrade card is static text '장비 상인 / 무기 선택 · 구매 · 판매' (HUD.luau:1908-1910).
- Config.NextGoal.RewardSamples/MaxKillsShown ('N마리 더!', Config.luau:1554-1556) is no longer used by the HUD.
- After the mission the player has about 120 + 5×3 = 135 gold, short of the 150-gold tier-2 weapon (Config.luau:157, 881, 916).
lessons.suggestion:
Keep one pinned next-goal row driven by real state:
- Gold under 150: '나무 검까지 N골드 · 슬라임 약 M마리', with M from recent kill rewards.
- Tier 2 owned: 'Lv5 철 검 800골드', then 'Lv10 고블린 숲'.
Use the existing quest row and upgrade card, text only. Never mention scrolls or rare drops until they exist.

lessons.lesson: Link activities to one goal to cut switching fatigue. Right now three dailies paying more than the first mission are visible from minute 0, which competes with the first mission.
lessons.quote: 여러 활동을 하나의 목표로 연결하고 개별 행동의 부담을 낮추면 활동을 전환하는 피로를 줄일 수 있다
lessons.status_evidence: On first join, onPlayerReady runs ensureSlots and runDayCheck (QuestService.luau:704-720), creating 3 dailies. publish lists them together with the tutorial (QuestService.luau:433-457). Each daily pays HuntValue(level, 5 minutes) (Config.luau:1002-1004; about 180g + 300XP per the task brief), more than the 120g first mission. The header shows the daily count (HUD.luau:2287), and on touch a claimable daily replaces the quest line (HUD.luau:2293-2296).
lessons.suggestion: Keep the daily reset bookkeeping, but don't show daily rows until the first mission is claimed (TutorialStep 99), or until the blacksmith visit. Alternatively, label dailies as funding the next weapon so they point to the same goal. Reward values change only with user approval.

lessons.lesson: Show price, current gold and owned quantity together, and separate 'button pressed' from 'server confirmed'. The potion flow is currently a dead end: the HUD says '구매' (buy) but there is no merchant.
lessons.quote: 가격·보유 골드·현재 물약 수량을 함께 읽고 구매할 수 있게 한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Config.Vitals.MerchantEnabled=false (Config.luau:33), so CanBuyPotions always returns false (ShopService.luau:204-205). VitalsUI shows status '구매' at 0 stock (VitalsUI.luau:47) with nowhere to buy. Server-side BuyPotion is already sound: distance, cap, price, debit before grant (ShopService.luau:238-264). The merchant template is the chibi costume 'Costume_HaloWarriorM' (Config.luau:34).
lessons.suggestion: Spawn a temporary default Roblox-style R15 NPC as the potion merchant (decision 3), enable the prompt, and build the PotionShop panel on the WeaponShop pattern: price, total gold, stock/cap, pending vs confirmed via attributes, and a reason when buying fails. Until it is live, replace '구매' with a non-actionable status or hide the potion buttons. Confirm with the user that 10 gold per potion is OK; it is a provisional value.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: PotionMerchantTemplate uses a chibi costume, but decision 3 removed costumes (use a default Roblox NPC). Note line 620 says 'approved GPT draft', but images are now Firefly and art comes later.

lessons.lesson: Good shop UI lets you compare offers at a glance. The weapon shop already shows price, gold and shortfall, but not what the purchase changes (attack power).
lessons.quote: 가격·시너지·기물 종류를 빠르게 구분하는 것이 UI의 목적
lessons.status_evidence: The WeaponShop panel shows current weapon, total gold (bank + pouch), price / required Lv / current Lv, shortfall WeaponShortF, owned/equipped state and pending→confirmed reconcile (Panels.luau:1753-1792, 1804-1915). WSHOP.Offer info has no Damage field (Panels.luau:1753-1760), so rows don't show the 8→15→38 base damage steps (Config.luau:156-158). On purchase there is an Upgrade burst plus a '장착!' toast (ShopService.luau:100-102).
lessons.suggestion: Add one text line per row, e.g. '공격력 8 → 15', or hits needed to kill a slime. Highlight the affordable or next row using existing theme colours only; no new art.

lessons.lesson: A growth step should be felt immediately in combat. Observation (needs a playtest): manual swings still deal only 50% damage, a leftover of the removed charge system.
lessons.quote: 확실한 변화와 소리가 좋은 아이템임을 배우게 한다고 설명한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Swing damage = weapon damage × BasicSkill.SwingImmediate 0.5 (CombatService.luau:731; Config.luau:295 and :299 'a swing that hits deals 50% ... right away', from the charge era). Tier-1 warrior: 4 per swing, so 3 swings per 10-HP slime. Tier 2: 7.5 per swing, so 2 swings (Config.luau:156-157, 881).
lessons.suggestion: Measure time-to-kill before and after buying tier 2 in Play. Ask the user whether manual swings should keep the 50% factor now that release stacks are gone. Don't change numbers without approval.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: The 50% immediate-damage rule belongs to the removed charge design (decision 2 removed charge); it is unclear whether keeping it is intended.

lessons.lesson: What a thing looks like must match what you can do with it. A bare anvil sells weapons while the HUD card says '장비 상인' (merchant), and the potion button says '구매' with no merchant anywhere.
lessons.quote: 플레이어가 겉모습으로 기대한 행동과 실제 가능한 행동이 어긋나면 몰입이 깨진다
lessons.status_evidence: The blacksmith prompt sits on the Anvil prop, with the comment 'create no new NPC or scenery' (ShopService.luau:152-170). The HUD card title is '장비 상인' (HUD.luau:1908). The potion button shows '구매' (VitalsUI.luau:47). On the good side, monsters have HP bars that signal 'attackable' (MonsterService.luau:531-537).
lessons.suggestion: Place a temporary default Roblox NPC beside the anvil with the same prompt and a name billboard (decision 3), keeping the anvil as the landmark. Audit leftover labels that suggest unavailable actions (potion '구매', the unused AutoOn text).
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: GDD.md:24 mentions an approved merchant illustration C, but decision 3 says use a temporary default Roblox NPC for now. Do not turn that illustration into 3D or UI art without approval.

lessons.lesson: Roblox's strength is showing your own avatar to friends. The note frames this as keeping chibi costumes; the current decision is to remove costumes and use the player's real avatar plus class weapon plus halo/horns.
lessons.quote: 승인된 치비 3D 스타일과 코스튬 ON/OFF를 유지한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Costumes are still the default: CostumeEnabled=true (Config.luau:83), and CostumeService.desiredId builds Costume_<Faction><Class><Gender> (CostumeService.luau:56-63). The HUD portrait (a live ViewportFrame clone of the character, HUD.luau:1681-1715) has costume-specific framing constants (HUD.luau:1644-1647). The halo/horns FactionMark already works on any rig (CharacterVisuals.luau:365-412).
lessons.suggestion: Apply decision 3: stop applying chibi costumes (default off, or disable the service), keep the real avatar plus class weapon plus FactionMark. The live portrait will then show the real avatar; re-check framing on different avatar sizes and drop the costume branch. Stop HaloArcherM face and R2 work.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Superseded by decision 3: note lines 13, 24 and 35 (chibi style, costume ON/OFF, HaloArcherM face, R2) and RELEASE_PLAN beta 1 ('직업 아바타 18종 연결').

lessons.lesson: If selection-screen art doesn't match the in-game model, beginners can't connect the two. The class picker shows illustrated characters, while in game the player is now their own Roblox avatar. The video also cautions that 3D is not automatically better.
lessons.quote: 구매 화면의 2D 일러스트와 실제 3D 기물이 다르면 초보자가 같은 대상을 연결하기 어렵다
lessons.status_evidence: ClassPicker.luau:592 uses the 'Char'..faction..class illustrations (Config.luau:1166-1170; several are marked 'blocked upload 2026-10-03').
lessons.suggestion: Art comes later. When class art is redrawn in Roblox style with Firefly (user approval first), show class identity through the weapon and halo/horns rather than a different body. A live avatar preview in the picker is a UI change that needs approval; don't invent styling in code.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Decision 3 (redraw in Roblox style later) and decision 4 (Firefly, approval first).

lessons.lesson: Make text readable first: compare title, body and number size and weight on the real HUD. The §9 code caps that shrink HUD text are still in place.
lessons.source: video_reference_notes_2026-10-04.md:27 (beta 4) + §9 553-601; Yellot UI 8-zDed5iU_w 2:37, 8:32 (watched); GDC 15:33 cited, §8 not read by me
lessons.quote: 제목·본문·숫자의 크기와 굵기, 여백을 실제 HUD에서 비교한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Size caps: artLabel title 13 / body 12 (HUD.luau:473); 13/12 at HUD.luau:703-704; XP 11 at :720; upgrade card 13/12/11 at :1486-1488. Minimum size min(11, floor(11/s)) at :424. Outline thinned to 0.4 thickness / 0.65 transparency at :451 and :472. Desktop scale 0.8 with a 0.6 floor (Config.luau:1090-1091).
lessons.suggestion: Measure TextBounds and effective px at 1280x720, 1366x768, 1920x1080 and phone 375x812 (Studio emulation). Raise the caps and outline inside the approved frames. Keep the user-chosen font and art. Fix only what is unreadable.

lessons.lesson: Test several devices and aspect ratios. Scale settings alone don't guarantee readable text, and approved art must not be squashed or pushed off-centre.
lessons.quote: Scale로 바꾸는 것만으로 글자가 읽히는 크기까지 보장되지는 않는다.
lessons.status_evidence: UIScale formula at UIKit.luau:60-61 and :255. The touch layout is placed around the Roblox jump button (HUD.luau:3061-3071, 2880-2903). The touch layout has no portrait (HUD.luau:1683).
lessons.suggestion: Do one emulation pass (phone portrait and landscape, tablet, 16:9 and 4:3 desktop) and save screenshots. Check that the attack, skill, potion and future auto buttons don't overlap the thumbstick or jump, that touch targets are about 44px or larger, and that art keeps its aspect. Don't install plugins; AutoScale was not chosen.

lessons.lesson: Phone controls: main buttons must not overlap the move and jump touch areas. With manual-only combat, phone players tap for every swing, so tap fatigue is the phone risk.
lessons.quote: 주요 버튼은 이동·점프 터치 영역과 겹치지 않아야 한다.
lessons.status_evidence: One press sends one Swing (HUD.luau:2613-2622). The touch attack button is bound at HUD.luau:2726-2745. A short world click attacks only on release (HUD.luau:3075-3077). The Archer swings every 0.5s (Config.luau:256), i.e. up to 2 taps per second.
lessons.suggestion: On phone emulation, check tap cadence and thumb reach for attack and skill. The optional auto toggle (main-a-01) is the intended relief, so place it within thumb reach. Do not bring back hold-to-repeat.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Note line 15's 'auto attack + timing release' is superseded.

lessons.lesson: With several players and effects on screen, you must still tell faces, targets, faction marks and remaining HP apart, and keep performance acceptable.
lessons.quote: 얼굴·목표·진영 표식·남은 체력이 여러 명의 공격 효과 속에서도 구분되는지 본다.
lessons.status_evidence:
Already present:
- FactionMark (CharacterVisuals.luau:365-412).
- Nametag with title, Lv, class, bully mark and bounty stars (CharacterVisuals.luau:237-300).
- WantedGlow highlight (CharacterVisuals.luau:790-801).
