lessons.suggestion: In the 3-client test, check whether you can identify your target, ally vs enemy, and enemy HP in PvP zones while skills fire. Log FPS. If enemy HP can't be read, propose a nametag HP line to the user (visual change, approval needed).

lessons.lesson: In shared-server help, plunder and chase moments, both the actor and the victim must understand what happened. Record win rate and victim annoyance in tests with 3 or more players.
lessons.quote: 누가 무엇을 했고 왜 추격 대상이 됐는지 알 수 있음. 승률과 당한 쪽의 불쾌감을 함께 기록.
lessons.status_evidence: Messages and markers exist: Plundered (Config.luau:1577), SackLore (Config.luau:1543), the grudge ghost label '<victim>의 원한' (CharacterVisuals.luau:673-690) and bounty stars on the nametag (CharacterVisuals.luau:285-295). GDD.md:42 states that multiplayer verification has not been done.
lessons.suggestion: Run a Studio test with 3 or more clients (RELEASE_PLAN beta 8) covering plunder, chase/recover, goose and kaiju. For each event log: did both sides understand the cause, the win rate, and victim annoyance on a 1-5 scale. Fix messages before numbers.

lessons.lesson: Pick the core fun and line every system up with it. For us that is GDD §0 (every action tilts toward angel or devil), but the first 10 minutes contain no tilt at all; the first Honor/Infamy chance arrives at Lv10.
lessons.quote: “누구를 돕거나 털 것인가”는 핵심 선택으로 유지하고, 그 결과가 외형·표식·보상에 연결된다는 사실을 실제 사건으로 이해하게
lessons.status_evidence: Honor and Infamy come only from PvP and grudges (PvPService.luau:552-585, 784; GrudgeService.luau:139). Slime Meadow has PvP=false (Config.luau:732). The first PvP zone, Goblin Woods, opens at Lv10 (Config.luau:735), about 10-12 minutes in (Config.luau:140). In the first minutes the only faction touches are the faction-flavoured guide dialogue (Config.luau:920-950) and war points from kills (Config.luau:595) feeding the war meter (HUD.luau:1840-1864). The Halo skill heals allies (CombatService.luau:906-925) but grants no Honor.
lessons.suggestion: Make the existing contribution visible early, e.g. a toast like '내 사냥이 빛의 기사단 점수 +1' using the existing WarPoints. At the Lv10 unlock, explain the help/hunt vs plunder choice that opens. New Honor-for-helping rules are a design change, so ask the user. Keep control learning (the auto quest) separate from faction choice.

lessons.lesson: Accumulated choices should show on the body (halo, horns, wings) so other players can read them at a glance.
lessons.quote: 정식에는 누적 선택의 헤일로·뿔·날개 표현을 승인 시안대로 강화한다.
lessons.status_evidence: FactionMark grows with title rank (CharacterVisuals.luau:377-378) but is built from plain Neon parts. There are no wings.
lessons.suggestion: This is launch scope. Make Firefly drafts first and get user approval, and check that they fit real Roblox avatars of all sizes.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: The note says GPT drafts; images are now Firefly (decision 4).

lessons.lesson: Show a danger before the player suffers it. Monster wind-ups already do this, but the plunder rule (carried gold can be stolen) is mostly explained only after it happens.
lessons.quote: 생김새만으로 알기 어려운 위험은 플레이어가 먼저 당하기 전에 눈앞의 사건으로 보여 주자
lessons.status_evidence: Monster wind-up telegraph exists (MonsterService.luau:91-105). On PvP entry the toast says only 'PvP 지역이에요! 다른 진영을 조심하세요.' (Config.luau:1565; ZoneService.luau:327-333). The unlock line is '도둑을 조심해!' (Config.luau:1548). The concrete rule appears only after being robbed (Config.luau:1577, 1543).
lessons.suggestion: Put the concrete rule in the Lv10 zone guide (HUD.luau:2588) and the PvP entry toast, e.g. '들고 있는 골드는 뺏길 수 있어요 · 금고에 먼저'. Text only.

lessons.lesson: Practise at low risk first, then raise the stakes, and let the player feel an item's effect directly. Combat practice is safe, but potions (and later scrolls) can't be experienced at all.
lessons.quote: 초보자가 첫 공격·발사·물약 구매를 안전하게 연습하고 효과를 확인할 수 있는지 검토한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Safe start: Slime Meadow is non-PvP (Config.luau:732), slimes do 2 damage (Config.luau:881), PvE death costs no gold unless you are wanted (PvPService.luau:426-444), respawn takes 3s (Config.luau:13), and no personal monster spawns in town (QuestService.luau:3). Missing: potions have no source (merchant disabled, Config.luau:33) and there are no scroll drops.
lessons.suggestion: Once the merchant is live, ask the user whether the first mission or an early drop should give a single HP potion so its effect is learned by use. Note line 349 forbids changing economy values without approval.

lessons.lesson: Visible hit reactions (numbers, flash, recoil, hit-stop) make the same damage feel finished. We already have them; what's left is a direct-input check.
lessons.quote: 같은 피격·체력 감소 기능이라도 시각적 반응을 더하면 체감 완성도가 달라진다
lessons.status_evidence: showHits draws damage numbers, a crit pop, monster flash, recoil, hit-stop and camera kick (Fx.luau:3085-3151). Monsters are shoved after hits (CombatService.luau:34-44). Attacks use stock Roblox tool animations (Fx.luau:94-100).
lessons.suggestion: Don't add effects. Playtest by direct input on real Roblox avatars (costumes removed) and confirm the attack reads clearly; GDD.md:42 lists this as unverified.

lessons.lesson: A button's response reassures the player the input was received. We have press feedback; only a skill press during cooldown is silent.
lessons.quote: 버튼의 반응이 입력을 제대로 받았다는 확신을 준다는 설명이다.
lessons.status_evidence: UIKit buttons shrink on press and play a click sound (UIKit.luau:335-368). HUD buttons use pressScale (HUD.luau:521-528). Low MP shows a toast (HUD.luau:2634-2642). A skill press during cooldown returns silently, with only the timer label visible (HUD.luau:1869-1881).
lessons.suggestion: Optionally add a throttled '재사용 대기' toast when the skill is pressed during cooldown, and verify the response on touch.

lessons.lesson: Show what was earned and where it went (a rising number, or the reward flying into the UI). Never make the actual grant wait for the animation; the server result must equal the HUD.
lessons.quote: 보상 숫자 증가, 보상 물체가 튀고 UI로 이동하는 과정으로 무엇을 얻었으며 어디에 반영되는지 보여 준다.
lessons.status_evidence: Kills show floating '+N G' / '+N XP' with a coin sound and combo bump (Fx.luau:3377-3398), plus a burst for golden monsters. The HUD gold text updates instantly with no pulse (HUD.luau:1760-1762). There are no item drops in src at all (no loot or scroll code).
lessons.suggestion: When scroll drops are built: show the drop popping out and being collected into the bag/HUD, while the server-authoritative grant stays independent of the animation. A small pulse on the gold line when it rises is motion on existing UI; check with the user if it changes the look.

lessons.lesson: Scale effect strength by importance: frequent events short, big moments distinct. This matters more once auto mode multiplies hit and kill events.
lessons.quote: 평타·보통 보상은 짧게, 중요한 명중·레벨 상승·큰 보상은 구분되는 강도로
lessons.status_evidence: Tiers already exist: crits scale 1.45 with a pop (Fx.luau:3117-3131), golden burst, level-up pillar plus announcement (Fx.luau:3407-3418), camera kick on manual hits only (CombatService.luau:802). However, every kill plays the coin sound and bumps the combo (Fx.luau:3377-3379).
lessons.suggestion: Send auto hits through the Manual=false path (no kick). Check that per-kill coin sounds and combo bumps aren't tiring at auto kill rates. Reserve big effects for level-up, first weapon purchase and rare drops.

lessons.lesson: Split skills into wind-up → launch → hit → end, and make motion, effect, sound and damage timing line up.
lessons.quote: 스킬의 **준비 동작 → 발사/이동 → 명중 → 종료**를 나누어 모션·효과·소리·피해 시점이 맞는지 검토한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Per-class Launch/Flight/Contact timings exist (CombatService.luau:53-66), and the client shows numbers at ContactDelay (Fx.luau:3193-3197, 3266). But server damage and kills resolve immediately (comment at CombatService.luau:52), so a monster might die before the projectile visually lands. Unverified.
lessons.suggestion: In Play, watch Mage and Archer swings and skills, auto-fired ones included. If death visibly precedes contact, delay only the client death visual; don't move server damage.

lessons.lesson: Check skill cooldown and 'no repeat damage from one cast' as separate guarantees, and keep server authority and the MP contract.
lessons.quote: 재사용 쿨타임과 같은 공격의 중복 피해 제한을 별개로 검증한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Release checks the server cooldown and spends MP (CombatService.luau:824-834). Each monster is damaged once per Release (CombatService.luau:865-884). Remotes are rate-limited (Config.luau:1069).
lessons.suggestion: Auto skill firing must reuse CombatService.Release so the guarantees hold. Add a check that pressing the skill manually while auto fires cannot double-cast or double-charge MP.

lessons.lesson: Fast-activating skills are inherently stronger, so their damage needs tuning. An auto mode that fires skills on time could change our balance.
lessons.quote: 발동 지연이 짧아 다른 기술보다 유리하므로 피해량 조정이 필요하다고 설명한다.
lessons.status_evidence: BasicSkill: 6× damage, radius 9, MP 20, 3s cooldown (Config.luau:294-297). MP regenerates 4/s (Config.luau:23), so the sustainable rate is about one skill every 5s, and auto would always hit that rate.
lessons.suggestion: Before beta, measure kills per minute for manual vs auto on slimes and goblins and show the user. Numbers stay the user's call; GDD §0-2 says they can be adjusted after play.

lessons.lesson: Keep effects kid-friendly (the video's blood-stained hand is excluded). One existing icon shows a cartoon blood drop with the label '흡혈' (bloodsucking).
lessons.quote: 피 묻은 손 표현은 우리 게임에 적용하지 않는다.
lessons.status_evidence: No gore found in Fx. IconBloodSword (Config.luau:1189) is used for the Horns perk with Short text '흡혈' (Config.luau:1424). art/ui/UIP_IconBloodSword.png, which I viewed, shows a red drop under crossed swords. Its old upload is marked 'blocked upload 2026-10-03'.
lessons.suggestion: Show this icon and wording to the user as a moderation-risk item before re-uploading on the new account. Consider '체력 흡수' wording. Any replacement art goes through Firefly with approval.

lessons.lesson: Check grip position and angle, and that projectiles start from the hand or weapon. Our bow is a LeftHand weld, not a Tool, so Tool Grip Editor doesn't apply. Real avatars of varied body types are now the risk.
lessons.source: video_reference_notes_2026-10-04.md:25 (beta 2) + :177 + :200 + :212 (plugins J7RVD-6VJkg 3:22-4:43, full playback; 3:45 grip screen)
lessons.quote: 현재 게임의 활은 Tool이 아니라 LeftHand에 자체 Weld로 연결한 구조
lessons.status_evidence: The bow is built and mounted to the LeftHand (CharacterVisuals.luau:474, 527-580), with a HandBowRest attribute (CharacterVisuals.luau:580). Attacks use stock Roblox slash/lunge animations (Fx.luau:94-100).
lessons.suggestion: With costumes off (decision 3), test sword, staff and bow grips and projectile origin on default R15, tall Rthro and small avatars (and R6 if allowed). Fix offsets in CharacterVisuals; don't switch to Tool-based weapons.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: The beta-2 wording about 18 class avatars is superseded by decision 3.

lessons.lesson: Transitions should signal movement and state change, and arrival should say where you are and whether friends are in the same area.
lessons.quote: 장면 전환 효과는 단순 장식보다 이동과 상태 변화를 알려 주는 역할
lessons.status_evidence: A 3s travel channel bar exists (HUD.luau:1951), and a guide beam points to the meadow pad (HUD.luau:2430-2441, 2563-2564). Zone toasts fire only on PvP↔safe changes (ZoneService.luau:327-336), and the zone chip shows only Safe or PvP (HUD.luau:1804-1814). There is no region-name banner on arrival.
lessons.suggestion: Show the region name briefly on arrival (e.g. '말랑 초원 · 안전'), text first. Any new visual treatment needs approval.

lessons.lesson: Check world-attached UI (names, HP bars) for distance, occlusion and lighting separately; don't make everything always-on-top.
lessons.quote: 월드에 붙는 UI는 거리·가림·조명 영향을 별도로 확인한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Monster HP bars: AlwaysOnTop=false with MaxDistance (MonsterService.luau:531-537). Nametags: MaxDistance 120 (Config.luau:1040; CharacterVisuals.luau:237-244). Guide label: AlwaysOnTop with a huge MaxDistance (HUD.luau:2496-2500). Damage numbers: pooled and AlwaysOnTop (Fx.luau:795-800).
lessons.suggestion: Give the temporary merchant NPCs name billboards with LightInfluence 0, not always-on-top, and a modest distance. Check that the guide label doesn't collide with nametags in a crowded town.

lessons.lesson: Show HP, MP, gold, potions and the next upgrade with consistent symbols plus short text, not colour alone. Keep details in menus, and don't show every system at minute 0.
lessons.source: video_reference_notes_2026-10-04.md:144 (Comme 47:58-51:03) + :348 (Mario) + :9 (Soul RPG detail separation, preview only)
lessons.quote: HP·MP·골드·물약 수량·다음 업그레이드의 상태는 기존 승인 그림과 일관된 기호·색·짧은 글자로 함께 전달
lessons.status_evidence: Money lines use IconCoin and IconPouch (HUD.luau:723-726). Potion buttons show icon, 'HP0개' and status (VitalsUI.luau:109-134, 160-163). The war meter and chips (HUD.luau:1789-1864) are all visible as soon as DataLoaded is set (HUD.luau:2926-2932), including potions that can't be bought and dailies.
lessons.suggestion: Audit a brand-new player's minute-0 screen. Hide or de-emphasise elements that can't be acted on yet and reveal them on unlock: potions until the merchant exists, dailies until the first mission. Hiding unusable elements is a usability fix; restyling needs approval.

lessons.lesson: The video separates out designs that pressure spending or manipulate odds, and our notes say not to copy them. Scroll enhancement must stay deterministic, with no failure, destruction or paid stats.
lessons.quote: 영상의 확률 보정·소비 유도 사례를 가져와 기존 경제 규칙이나 확률을 바꾸자는 제안은 아니다.
lessons.status_evidence: There is no scroll or loot system in src; only the IconScroll art key exists (Config.luau:1140), and it is used as a quest/picker icon (ClassPicker.luau:730). GDD.md:17 and :26 list scroll enhancement as remaining work.
lessons.suggestion: When building it: scrolls drop visibly from monsters, N scrolls give a guaranteed +1, and the enhancement level shows in the shop and HUD. The numbers (N, drop rates) come from the user. Don't reuse the quest IconScroll for the item without approval.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Any probability, gacha or failure pattern from videos conflicts with decision 5 (no enhancement failure, item destruction or stat monetization).

lessons.lesson: Finish a small scope and keep the feature freeze. Don't turn features seen in videos into release conditions.
lessons.quote: **10/24 기능 마감**을 유지하며, 영상에서 본 기능을 추가 출시 조건으로 늘리지 않는다.
lessons.status_evidence: Process lesson. RELEASE_PLAN.md:37-50 is the beta list. The 2026-10-05 decisions add scope (auto toggle plus optional quest, temporary NPC merchants, scroll drops) and none of it is coded yet.
lessons.suggestion: List the new decision items against the 10/24 freeze and build the first-10-minute loop items first. Keep crafting, codex, fishing and similar features from the RPG videos out of beta.

lessons.lesson: Validate the core fun with a rough playable build before scaling up. For us that means timing a real new-player first 10 minutes before any art work.
lessons.quote: 규모를 키우기 전 핵심 재미를 거친 프로토타입으로 확인하고 재미가 약하면 이 단계에서 다시 검토
lessons.status_evidence: GDD.md:42 says the following are unverified: Studio integration, direct-input feel, real reconnect saving, multiplayer, and a natural new-player 10 minutes.
lessons.suggestion: With a fresh save key, play 10 minutes and timestamp: faction pick, mission accept, first kill, mission claim, blacksmith, first purchase, Lv5, Lv10. Flag any stretch over 60s with no clear next action, and report solved/total issues.

lessons.lesson: When asking AI (or yourself) to review, name the event, input, expected response and observed gap, and bundle measurable issues instead of open-ended restyling.
lessons.quote: 현재 사건·입력·응답·관찰된 부족함을 지정해 검토시키는 방식을 참고한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Process lesson; no code involved.
lessons.suggestion: Track issues as {event, input, expected, observed, measure (px, ms, taps)} and report the solved/total count, as AGENTS.md requires.

lessons.lesson: Control feel comes from predictability and matching the player's intent. Our press and click rules are right, but auto-picked targets are invisible.
lessons.quote: 조작감의 핵심을 현실성보다 예측 가능성과 플레이어 의도에 맞는 반응으로 설명한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Implemented: one press = one swing (HUD.luau:2613-2622); a world click attacks only on release while drag rotates the camera (HUD.luau:3075-3077); a 0.2s grace queue (CombatService.luau:25); a whiff fires forward (CombatService.luau:28). Gap: Mage and Archer auto-pick the nearest target (CombatService.luau:646-700) with no indicator of which one.
lessons.suggestion: In the playtest, check whether players can predict which slime the archer or mage will hit. If not, propose a subtle target highlight (visual change, approval needed). Auto mode must use the same predictable rule.

lessons.lesson: Small living details (environment hit reactions, footstep particles, wind-up and follow-through) add up, but they cost production time.
lessons.quote: 환경의 타격 반응, 발밑 입자, 짧은 준비·마무리 동작, 시선과 이동 자세가 세계와 캐릭터를 살아 있게 만든다
lessons.status_evidence: Monster wind-up and recoil already exist (MonsterService.luau:91-105; Fx.luau:3138-3151). I found no footstep or environment reactions (not searched exhaustively).
lessons.suggestion: Defer until after the gameplay pass (decision 1). Any new look needs approval.

lessons.lesson: Much of the plugin and solo-dev video content isn't needed for a gameplay-first beta: sky/sun tool, Realism Mod ragdoll/fall damage, GapFill, waterfall, mesh editor, and business/tax advice.
lessons.quote: 이번 자료 작성으로 플러그인 설치·화면 제어·유료 작업을 허용하지 않는다.
lessons.status_evidence: Nothing to implement. AGENTS.md hard rule 6 and the paid-work rules also apply.
lessons.suggestion: Skip for beta. Don't install plugins.

lessons.lesson: After the first reward and the blacksmith visit, the player must always see one concrete next growth goal with the gold or level still needed. Today the guidance ends there.
lessons.source: §12 (note line 638) + game_reference_untitled_rpg §3 '성장 목표' row, from 코대 guide GV5zZLF-nD8 storyboards
lessons.quote: 우리에게 가져올 점은 ... 첫 보상 뒤 다음 성장 목표다. / 첫 보상을 받은 뒤 다음 목표·필요 골드·다음 지역을 스스로 찾는지 검사.
lessons.status_evidence: QuestService.luau:409-415 returns nil once BlacksmithVisited, so nothing stays pinned. HUD.luau:1908-1910 shows a fixed upgrade card ('장비 상인 / 무기 선택 · 구매 · 판매') with no price or progress. Config.NextGoal (Config.luau:1554-1559, 'N마리 더!') is no longer used by HUD; only the comment at HUD.luau:1420 remains. The zone guide fires only at Lv10/Lv25 (HUD.luau:2572-2590). Economy check: 5 slimes x 3G (Config.luau:881) + 120G reward (Config.luau:916) = 135G, which is less than the 150G wood weapon (Config.luau:157).
lessons.suggestion: Once the blacksmith is visited, pin a chained next objective in the tutorial slot (for example a short 왕 슬라임 hunt or reaching Lv5 to unlock the iron option). Make the blacksmith card show information-only progress toward the cheapest unowned basic weapon (for example '나무 무기까지 15G · 약 5마리'), reusing Config.NextGoal. Keep it phrased as a choice and never as a requirement.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Decision 5 says the next weapon is bought by choice. Show progress as information, never as a forced purchase step.

lessons.lesson: Teach one thing at a time. Daily quests that show from minute 0 compete with the 5-slime first mission and dilute 'what do I do now'.
lessons.source: §7.2 콤므 tutorial video gGWW68gmQd8 (auto subtitles read in full + 3 frames)
lessons.quote: 첫 진입에서 진영·직업·사냥·발사 타이밍·보상·업그레이드·PvP 규칙을 한꺼번에 설명하지 않는지 검사한다.
lessons.status_evidence: The tutorial is pinned first (QuestService.luau:432-433), but the 3 daily slots go out in the same publish (QuestService.luau:434-456). Daily templates ask for 50-60 kills (Config.luau:971, 975), so a brand-new player sees 4 objectives at once.
lessons.suggestion: Keep the dailies generated server-side but hide or collapse their HUD rows until TutorialStep==99 and the first chained goal is done. Then reveal them with one toast ('일일 임무가 열렸어요'). Rewards are not lost.

lessons.lesson: First actions should be practised at low risk, with the effect felt immediately: attack, then skill, then potion. A rule should be shown before it hurts the player.
lessons.source: §7.2 콤므 tutorial gGWW68gmQd8 (Mario Goomba ordering, Half-Life barnacle)
lessons.quote: 초보자가 첫 공격·발사·물약 구매를 안전하게 연습하고 효과를 확인할 수 있는지 검토한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Low-risk start exists: SlimeMeadow has PvP=false (Config.luau:731-733), slimes have HP10 and deal 2 damage (Config.luau:881), and monster hits are telegraphed (MonsterService.luau:1341-1361, Fx.luau:2758). Potion practice is impossible: counts start at 0 (Config.luau:85-86) and the merchant is disabled (Config.luau:33). The first mission never prompts the MP20/3s skill.
lessons.suggestion: Add a one-line skill hint during the 5-slime mission ('Q/스킬 버튼: MP 20'). Let the player get 1-2 HP potions inside the first 10 minutes, either through a working merchant (main-b-04) or as a mission gift. The potion count or gift is an economy value, so ask the user first.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Free starter potions change the economy and need user approval.

lessons.lesson: The potion shop should run end to end on one screen, from finding the NPC to seeing price, owned gold and stock, then the server-confirmed result. This is beta must-have item 3.
lessons.source: §10 Soul RPG UQ7zRWzcIgo ~7:35 row; §11 6Mo0ZJyRnQM 3:20-3:45 row; §12 '물약 NPC를 찾는 동선'
lessons.quote: 물약 NPC에서 가격·보유 골드·물약 수량을 함께 확인하고 구매하게 한다.
lessons.status_evidence: The server BuyPotion path with validation exists (ShopService.luau:204-268), and so does the prompt builder ('물약 구매/물약 상인', MapBuilder.luau:808-848). It is disabled by Config.luau:33 (MerchantEnabled=false, waiting on a 'GPT potion-shop preview'). The NPC template is a chibi costume rig, 'Costume_HaloWarriorM' (Config.luau:34).
lessons.suggestion: Turn the merchant on with a temporary default Roblox-style NPC beside the Crossroads spawn, using no costume rig. The buy UI should reuse existing approved panel parts and show 10G each, owned gold and stock x/99. Test debit/stock, the shortfall reason, rapid taps, distance and respawn.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: The config comment waits on a GPT preview, but GPT is cancelled (decision 4, Firefly now). The template uses a chibi costume, which decision 3 removed. Ask the user whether reusing existing approved panel art is acceptable.

lessons.lesson: The guide and the shopkeepers should be physical NPCs in a town whose buildings say what they do, so 'talk to the guide' and 'visit the blacksmith' are walk-to actions.
lessons.source: game_reference_untitled_rpg §2 row 0:40-1:25 and §3 '첫인상·마을 안내' (코대 guide storyboards 0-1)
lessons.quote: 마을 건물에 기능 이름이 붙고, NPC 가까이에서 상호작용 표시와 판매·조합 화면을 연다.
lessons.status_evidence: The guide exists only in the menu: Config.luau:919 says 'no world NPC is spawned by this dialogue', and Config.luau:947 reads '첫 임무 · 메뉴에서 안내자 만나기'. The blacksmith is an anvil prompt ('무기 보기 / 마을 대장간', ShopService.luau:140-170). The altar and goose perch have billboard signs (MapBuilder.luau:652, 756), but I found no blacksmith sign in MapBuilder.
lessons.suggestion: Spawn temporary default Roblox NPCs for 안내자 and 대장장이 at Crossroads, each with a ProximityPrompt and a text-only name billboard in the existing font. Point the existing guide beam (HUD showGuide) at them. weapon_progression decision #8 already says all shops are NPCs.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: None, since decision 3 allows temporary default NPCs. Any final NPC art needs Firefly options and user approval first.

lessons.lesson: Use a short quest step to teach each town service, such as selling or buying, instead of explaining it.
lessons.source: 코대 guide GV5zZLF-nD8, guide_storyboard_04/05 burned-in captions (my reading; not recorded in the notes)
lessons.quote: 전당포에 가서 딱 10개만 팔아줘야 합니다
lessons.status_evidence: The only service step is 'VisitBlacksmith', which is just a visit (QuestService.luau:410-412; Config.luau:952). No step teaches buying a potion, selling a weapon (ShopService.luau:100-135) or using the skill.
lessons.suggestion: After the first mission, chain 1-2 single-action micro-steps, each with a visible small reward: 대장간 둘러보기 → 물약 상인에게서 HP 물약 받기/사기 → 왕 슬라임 처치. Each step is one action.

lessons.lesson: The reference game unlocks a feature (a skill) by finishing a quest. That supports the user's plan to unlock the auto-combat toggle through an optional quest right after faction selection.
lessons.source: 코대 guide guide_storyboard_11 caption (my reading; not in notes)
lessons.quote: 그리고 골렘 퀘를 다 깨면 스킬을 쓸 수 있는데요
lessons.status_evidence: Auto attacks are rejected: CombatService.luau:603 ('automatic attacks were removed') and :809, and :1159 forces AutoAttack=false. The SetAutoAttack remote (Net.luau:9) and HUD strings AutoOn/AutoOff (HUD.luau:148-149) are only leftovers, and the old 자동 square is gone (HUD.luau:1411-1418).
lessons.suggestion: Add an optional quest offered right after faction pick (for example '자동 사냥 훈련: 슬라임 N마리 직접 처치'). Its reward saves a server flag that unlocks a 자동 ON/OFF toggle, defaulting to OFF. In auto mode, basic attacks and the skill fire only at monsters; players can be hit only by manual input. Reuse the SetAutoAttack remote with server validation. Update SPEC A22 and AGENTS.md first.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: SPEC_ADDENDUM A22 and AGENTS.md still say auto is removed. The user's 2026-10-05 decision adds an opt-in toggle, and the docs must be updated to match before coding.

lessons.lesson: Auto mode needs AFK and macro limits so it does not become unattended farming.
lessons.source: 코대 guide guide_storyboard_02 caption (my reading; not in notes)
lessons.quote: 게임에 매크로 방지 시스템이 있어서 매크로는 안됨
lessons.status_evidence: A precedent exists only for the goose event: GooseService.luau:21-24 sets MIN_MANUAL_HITS=3 and does not pay auto-only AFK players. There is no general idle or AFK rule (grep for AFK/Idled finds nothing). Auto mode is not implemented.
lessons.suggestion: Set the rules alongside the toggle. Auto only targets monsters already in range or aggro and does not path-hunt. It pauses after a few minutes without movement or input. Goose, bounty and PvP rewards keep requiring manual input. Everything is enforced on the server.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Must stay within 'no single-button growth / no labor padding'. Auto is a convenience, not idle progression.

lessons.lesson: Decide what happens to enhancement when the player switches weapons. In the reference game, early enhancement is wasted because players change weapons every tier.
lessons.source: 코대 guide guide_storyboard_01 caption; Soul RPG UQ7zRWzcIgo storyboard_10 ('+0 / +50', '강화 코어') (my reading; not in notes)
lessons.quote: 근데 초반에는 징비마다 무기 갈아타야 해서 초반 강화는 ㄴ
lessons.status_evidence: There is no scroll or enhancement code on the server (grep for Scroll/Enhance finds none). IconScroll is only a quest icon (HUD.luau:2127, 2342). weapon_progression_user_decisions_2026-10-04.md lists '강화 수치가 다른 티어로 넘어갈 때의 처리' as undecided.
lessons.suggestion: Before building scroll drops, have the user pick one rule: (a) the enhancement level carries over to a newly bought basic weapon, (b) scrolls spent are refunded on swap, or (c) early scrolls mostly drop where the weapon is used long enough. Success stays guaranteed: no failure and no item destruction.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Do not copy Soul RPG's +50 cap or core-based limit-break numbers. Never add failure or destruction (decision 5).

lessons.lesson: Harder monster variants should drop rare loot much more often. In the guide, armored goblins drop cores at 10% against 1% for normal ones.
lessons.source: 코대 guide guide_storyboard_07 caption (my reading; not in notes)
lessons.quote: 코어는 일반-1%, 갑옷-10%로 확률로 얻을 수 있습니다
lessons.status_evidence: A golden variant exists at 4%, with 3x HP, 10x gold and 3x XP (Config.luau:860-863), and so do the elites GoblinBrute and SkeletonKnight (Config.luau:884, 886). Kills pay only XP, gold and war points (MonsterService.luau:1038-1047), with no item drops.
lessons.suggestion: When scrolls ship, weight scroll drops by difficulty: golden and elite monsters get a much higher rate. Guarantee the first scroll through a quest, and show the drop clearly where it happens.

lessons.lesson: Hand out key materials through quest progress, and avoid unlock gates that need hundreds or thousands of repetitions.
lessons.source: 코대 guide storyboards 07-08, 10, 12 captions (my reading; not in notes)
lessons.quote: 고블린의 분노를 만드는데에 피가 999개가 필요합니다 / 다이아몬드는 진행중에 줘서 모을 필요는 없습니다
lessons.status_evidence: No crafting or scrolls exist yet. Dailies are sized to about 5 minutes (Config.luau:989 QuestMinutes=5; 50-60 slime kills at Config.luau:971). The guide's 999-blood, 1000-kill skill book and 500-dash awakening gates have no counterpart in our game.
lessons.suggestion: When designing scroll counts and boss-material crafting, keep the counts small, for example single-digit scrolls per step, and grant the first unit of each new material through a quest. Never add 500-1000 repetition unlocks.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: The guide's grind gates conflict with 'no forced repetitive labor' (persona/decision 5), so do not adopt them.

lessons.lesson: Show the zone name, level and safety in a banner when the player enters an area, not only on gate signs.
lessons.quote: 초원에서 연못을 지나 사막으로 이동하며 지역명이 표시된다.
lessons.status_evidence: Gate signs show '이름 Lv N+ PvP/안전' (MapBuilder.luau:216-222). Pad labels exist (MapBuilder.luau:224-226), and the Travel panel shows 'Lv %d 필요' and '추천' (Panels.luau:96-100, 1352-1363). On ZoneChanged the game only shows PvP or safe toasts (ZoneService.luau:328-336), with no name banner, so players arriving by pad or travel skip the gate sign.
lessons.suggestion: On ZoneChanged, show a 2-second ribbon such as '말랑 초원 · Lv 1+ · 안전 지역' using the existing toast or ribbon UI. No new art is needed.

lessons.lesson: Friends who came together should be able to see whether they are in the same area.
lessons.quote: 함께 온 친구와 같은 구역인지 확인할 수 있어야 한다.
lessons.status_evidence: WorldMap markers cover only self, goose, kaiju and, for Halo players, grudge-sack carriers (WorldMap.luau:1-7, 1683-1700). There are no friend or party markers.
lessons.suggestion: Add Roblox-friend markers (cached Player:IsFriendsWith) to the world map. Also show '친구 있음' next to destinations in the Travel panel.

lessons.lesson: In a 3+ player fight, the targets, enemy HP, faction marks and help or plunder outcomes must stay readable under big effects.
lessons.quote: 친구 3명 이상이 함께 공격할 때도 적·아군과 도움·털기 결과가 읽혀야 한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Overhead monster bars exist (MonsterService.luau:530-590, 796), as do hit-stop, camera kick and shake (Fx.luau:1420-1441, 3143, 3315). No multi-client run has been recorded. RELEASE_PLAN beta item 8 requires 3+ clients.
lessons.suggestion: Run a 3-client Studio test in SlimeMeadow and GoblinWoods. Record whether HP bars, names, halo or horns marks and plunder toasts stay visible. If not, make other players' hit effects lighter than your own.

lessons.lesson: Co-op works without a party because every contributor gets the kill reward. A future boss should require a minimum contribution, and the help should be visible.
lessons.source: 6Mo0ZJyRnQM storyboard_L3_09 caption (world boss); Soul RPG storyboard_05 party UI (my reading; not in notes)
lessons.quote: 난 7퍼 넘었으니까 다른 분들 먹을 수 있게
lessons.status_evidence: Every player who damaged a monster within 15s gets full rewards (Config.luau:858; MonsterService.luau:1049-1066). There is no party system.
lessons.suggestion: Keep the no-party sharing, since it fits Roblox friends who just join and hunt. For the 해골왕 boss, require a minimum share of damage or heals before loot, and show a '함께 처치' or help toast so co-op is legible and can tilt Halo under GDD §0. Rules need user approval.

lessons.lesson: Keep 'I pressed' and 'it hit' as separate feedback.
lessons.quote: 지금 입력할 때와 성공한 때를 구분.
lessons.status_evidence: The attack button press-scales the moment it is pressed and sends one Swing (HUD.luau:2612-2621). Server-confirmed hits drive showHits with hit-stop and kick (Fx.luau:3315). The skill is refused with 'MP가 부족해요.' (HUD.luau:2634-2641), and a cooldown timer label exists (HUD.luau:1408).
lessons.suggestion: Verify on a touch emulator. The tap should register instantly, damage or hurt feedback should appear only on a server hit, and a whiff should still show a forward swing. The skill timer must be readable.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: The note frames this as '타이밍 발사' / '자동 공격+타이밍 한 번 유지' (line 403, §11 line 631). That is superseded by manual combat (decision 2). Do not restore timing or charge.

lessons.lesson: Correct for what the player meant to do, not the literal input. The attack should hit the monster the player means, without demanding precise aim. 코대 complains about tiny goblin hitboxes and having to aim slightly in front.
lessons.source: §7.5 콤므 mu8WudcdqgY (matched to compilation r1vDkVqD0Z4 transcript 33:51-37:42); 코대 guide storyboards 04-05 captions
lessons.quote: 핵심은 입력 좌표 자체와 사용자가 원한 편한 스윙을 구분해 조작을 보정하는 것이다.
lessons.status_evidence: Swing auto-selects the nearest monster within class range, with Splash and Multi patterns and a forward whiff (CombatService.luau:636-700). Monster hits are cancelled if the target is beyond AttackRange+2 at impact (MonsterService.luau:1320).
lessons.suggestion: Keep the soft targeting. Add test cases for GoblinBrute (Scale 1.5) and for different personal Roblox avatar sizes, now that players use their own avatars. Confirm distance is measured root to root. When two targets are equally close, consider preferring the one the camera faces.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: The note suggests keeping '자동 공격과 한 번의 타이밍 입력' (line 403), which is obsolete. Manual press combat is the default.

lessons.lesson: The attack telegraph must match the real hit area. Elite and boss attacks need a ground telegraph.
lessons.source: game_reference §2 row 10:20-10:40; 코대 guide storyboard_06 caption
lessons.quote: 적 앞 바닥에 붉은 공격 영역과 공격 효과가 보인다. / (영상 자막) 게임이 판정이 좀 이상해서 피해도 맞은걸로 되는데
lessons.status_evidence: There is a 0.28s wind-up pose with red tint blinks (MonsterService.luau:97-98, 1341-1361; Fx.luau:2758), and damage is cancelled when the player has moved out of range, which is consistent. No ground-area indicator exists.
lessons.suggestion: Basic monsters are fine. For GoblinBrute, SkeletonKnight and the future 해골왕, add a ground area whose radius equals the server hit radius exactly, and test dodging under phone latency.

lessons.lesson: Give each zone an identity through one readable monster mechanic, not only bigger numbers.
lessons.source: 코대 guide storyboards 08-09, 13-14 captions (slow, curse, dash, bleed, circular AoE)
lessons.quote: 모래 슬라임은 공격 시 슬로우 / 무사들은 패시브와 고유스킬이 있습니다
lessons.status_evidence: The six monster types differ only in HP, damage, speed and scale (Config.luau:880-887).
lessons.suggestion: After beta, give one telegraphed mechanic per zone that fits the theme. For example, goblins could grab carried gold (it fits 털기) and skeleton knights could slam. Keep it kid-friendly, with no bleed or gore.

lessons.lesson: Level-gated areas should say why they are blocked and where to go instead. In the guide, under-level kills silently give nothing.
lessons.source: 코대 guide storyboard_04 caption; storyboard_11 '렙업은 사막이 젤 좋습니다'
lessons.quote: 최소레벨보다 본인 레벨이 낮은데 거기서 몹을 잡아도 레벨과 전리품이 들어오지 않습니다
lessons.status_evidence: Entry is bounced with '레벨 %d 이상만 들어갈 수 있어요!' (ZoneService.luau:307-310; Config.luau:1564), and attacks are gated as well (CombatService.luau:198-201). Gate signs show the level (MapBuilder.luau:216-222). The Travel panel shows 'Lv %d 필요' and an '추천' badge (Panels.luau:1352-1363). Lv10 is targeted at about 10-12 minutes (Config.luau:140).
lessons.suggestion: Keep this. Verify on phone that the bounce toast and the Lv10 GoblinWoods guide (HUD.luau:2572-2590) actually appear.

lessons.lesson: Keep the core status in one cluster: Lv, EXP, HP/MP numbers and potion quickslots, with the current quest and its count nearby.
lessons.source: §11 6Mo0ZJyRnQM 3:00-3:15 row; game_reference §5 (user HUD photo); 코대 storyboard_03 quickbar
lessons.quote: 레벨·성장 진행·HP·MP를 크기와 굵기로 구분해 한눈에 읽히게 한다.
lessons.status_evidence: The approved vitals block (HP/MP under XP, two potion buttons, quest block below) is in VitalsUI.luau:1 and HUD.luau:2835-2836. Potion keys are 1 and 2 (VitalsUI.luau:208-215), and quest progress is shown (QuestService.luau:404-408). Text sizes are small (see main-b-22).
lessons.suggestion: Keep the approved art. On phone and on 720p and 1080p desktop, check that values like '100/100' and the potion counts read before the labels do. Leave the centre of the screen clear for combat.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Do not copy the reference minimap, empty '없음' skill slots or layout. Approved art stays fixed.

lessons.lesson: Readable text first (GDC text UX, size criterion). HUD captions are capped at 11-14 physical px.
lessons.quote: artLabel()은 개별 TextSize·MaxTextSize를 받은 뒤 제목 13px/본문 12px 상한을 다시 적용한다.
lessons.status_evidence: The note's line numbers have shifted. Currently L.FitText caps are physical px (HUD.luau:414-435), with a min of floor(11/scale) at :424. artLabel title 13 / body 12 is at :473, the desktop level 14 at :642, title 13 / class 12 at :703-704 and XP 11 at :720. The touch floor of 15 units (11 real px) is at HUD.luau:71, 401-409.
lessons.suggestion: Measure TextBounds and actual pixels on a phone and at 720p. Raise the caps for HP/MP, gold and potion counts and the quest line inside the existing frames, without changing the artwork. Re-test with Korean and English.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Change text size only. Approved frames stay as they are, and new layouts need Firefly options plus approval.

lessons.lesson: Line length and width matter (GDC words-per-line criterion). Narrow fixed widths combined with no-wrap and auto-shrink make long Korean or English text shrink.
lessons.quote: HUD는 줄바꿈을 끄고 UIKit.FitText()가 칸에 맞춰 글자를 줄인다.
lessons.status_evidence: HUD.luau:447 sets TextWrapped=false, and the status card width is 280 (HUD.luau:57). The desktop scale is clamped to 0.6-1.0 (UIKit.luau:60-62; Config.luau:1089-1090), and UIKit.FitText is at UIKit.luau:887.
lessons.suggestion: Test long nicknames, titles and English (beta item 7). Allow two lines for quest text where the frame has room, rather than shrinking.

lessons.lesson: Keep the font hierarchy (number font and bold) instead of flattening everything to one face at Regular weight.
lessons.quote: 따라서 Number=true라고 해서 둥근 Fredoka 숫자가 실제로 유지되는 구조가 아니다.
lessons.status_evidence: The common font id 12187370747 is at UIKit.luau:23, and FredokaOne is mapped to Bold at UIKit.luau:140. Config declares Title, Body and Number fonts (Config.luau:1383-1385). HUD re-applies Regular to non-titles (HUD.luau:447-473).
lessons.suggestion: Keep the user's chosen font family but render numbers (HP, MP, gold, counts) in Bold. Do not swap the font family without the user's approval.

lessons.lesson: Text over busy frames and bright gauges needs a real outline.
lessons.quote: HUD는 두께 0.4·투명도 0.65로 바꾸고 기본 TextStroke도 끈다.
lessons.status_evidence: HUD.luau:448 turns TextStroke off, and HUD.luau:451 and :472 set UIStroke to 0.4 thickness at 0.65 transparency. UIKit.LightText defaults to a stronger stroke (UIKit.luau:748).
lessons.suggestion: Compare stroke values around 1.0/0.3 against the current 0.4/0.65 on the HP/MP bars in fixed-resolution captures. Then iterate, as the GDC closing slide on testing and revising says (27:46).

lessons.lesson: Separate what must be done now from rules the player can look up later, and let them re-check faction consequences and PvP rules (GMTK 'ACCEPT / MORE INFO').
lessons.quote: 선택한 진영의 결과·PvP 규칙을 다시 확인할 수 있는지 검사한다.
lessons.status_evidence: The B menu has Travel, Rebirth, Class, Shop, Map, Costume and Nickname, plus Welcome and Vacation when relevant (Panels.luau:1220-1235). The only extra text is the altar hint and mark lore (Panels.luau:1274-1275). PvP, plunder and bounty rules appear only as toasts (Config.luau:1565-1600). There is no rules page.
lessons.suggestion: Add a text-only '규칙' entry to the existing menu panel with about 5 lines: PvP zones are Lv10+, plunder fills a grudge sack held for 45s, Halo can return gold at 120%, towns are safe, and how faction choices tilt you.

lessons.lesson: Anything that looks interactive must do what it promises. Potion buttons show '0개' but potions cannot be bought anywhere, and the costume toggle remains although costumes were removed.
lessons.quote: 상호작용할 수 없는 장식을 버튼처럼 표현하지 않는지 확인한다.
lessons.status_evidence: The potion buttons always render 'HP0개' (VitalsUI.luau:152-160) while buying is disabled (Config.luau:33). The menu still lists 코스튬 ON/OFF (Panels.luau:1227, 1263-1264), and CostumeEnabled defaults to true (Config.luau:83).
lessons.suggestion: Until the merchant is live, the potion status should say where potions come from, or show the gift. Remove or hide the costume toggle per decision 3.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Decision 3 removed chibi costumes. The note (line 623) still says to keep '코스튬 ON/OFF', and that is superseded.

lessons.lesson: What the avatar holds and wears must match actual play. With players' own Roblox avatars, the weapon, halo and horns must attach correctly on any body.
lessons.quote: 구매 버튼은 누르면 예상한 구매 결과가 나오고, 캐릭터의 3D 프로필·진영 외형·손에 든 무기가 실제 플레이와 이어지는지 검토한다.
lessons.status_evidence: CharacterVisuals rebuilds the weapon from the WeaponTier attribute (ShopService.luau:3 comment). The costume pipeline is still active: CostumeService.luau, CostumeEnabled default true (Config.luau:83), and the merchant template is a costume rig (Config.luau:34).
lessons.suggestion: Test with several R15 avatar types (scale, packages, layered clothing): weapon grip, halo/horns placement, attack motion and the profile image. Retire the costume default path.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: The note's '현재 18종 아바타' (line 547) and the 3D chibi profile assumptions are superseded by decision 3 (own avatar + class weapon + halo/horns).

lessons.lesson: Game feel check: walking, jumping, attacking and getting hit should read clearly, and repeated-hunt effects must not cover the face, the target or the HUD.
lessons.source: §8.3 GMTK 216_5nu4aVQ (0:00-5:18 continuous playback, no audio or subtitles)
lessons.quote: 반복 사냥에서 과한 빛·입자·흔들림이 얼굴·목표·HUD를 가리지 않는지도 본다.
lessons.status_evidence: Shake, hit-stop and camera kick exist (Fx.luau:1420-1441, 3143, 3315), as do pain stickers and the wind-up telegraph (Fx.luau:9, 2758). They have not been verified with manual tap-per-attack combat.
lessons.suggestion: Record about 2 minutes of slime hunting on phone emulation with rapid taps. If the kick or shake fires on every normal hit, reduce it for normal hits and keep it for crits and skills.

lessons.lesson: Keep everything the player needs right now on the HUD, and put detailed class, skill and monster info in a list-plus-detail panel. A codex is not a beta requirement.
lessons.quote: 새 도감 시스템을 출시 조건으로 추가하지 않는다.
lessons.status_evidence: The Class panel (Panels.luau:1605) and the B menu exist. There is no monster or item codex (grep for 도감/Codex finds nothing).
lessons.suggestion: After drops exist, a simple monster list (zone, level, what it drops, including scrolls) could go in the B menu. Not for beta.

lessons.lesson: A training dummy that shows damage lets players feel the difference between weapons, which supports buying by choice.
lessons.source: user_hud_reference.png (user screenshot; '훈련장 · 아이템의 능력이 무엇인지 알아보세요' sign with Total/DPS meters; the note mentions only '훈련장이 보인다')
lessons.quote: 주요 UI가 가장자리에 있고 가운데 캐릭터·길·훈련장이 보인다.
lessons.status_evidence: No dummy or training area exists in src (grep for Dummy/훈련 finds nothing).
lessons.suggestion: Place 1-2 dummies near the Crossroads blacksmith that show damage per hit and DPS, so a player can compare wood and iron before or after buying. Reuse the existing hit Fx. Any new art needs approval.

lessons.lesson: Do not tease locked features that do not exist yet (the reference HUD has a chained '50Lv' button).
lessons.quote: 오른쪽의 `없음` 스킬 칸 3개 ... 그대로 옮기지 않을 점
lessons.status_evidence: RELEASE_PLAN says the '다음 해금' preview has been removed (manual combat section). Fx.luau:3 still mentions a level-up 'next unlock' announce in its header comment.
lessons.suggestion: Show only next goals that actually exist (main-b-01). Confirm the Fx 'next unlock' announce really is disabled.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: RELEASE_PLAN 2026-10-04 removed the '다음 해금' preview.

lessons.lesson: Retention events: a weekend boost, a limited event shop using an event currency, world bosses and a daily attendance reward.
lessons.source: 6Mo0ZJyRnQM storyboard_L3_00-02, 04, 09 captions; user_hud_reference.png '주말 드롭확률 x1.5' and attendance pickup (my reading)
lessons.quote: 다음 주 주말까지 주말 버프가 2배로
lessons.status_evidence: Dailies, a daily chest and a vacation catch-up exist (Config.luau:988-996). The goose runs every 10 minutes (Config.luau:629-630), and the kaiju event also exists. There is no seasonal shop or weekend buff.
lessons.suggestion: For launch, pair the planned Christmas decoration with a weekend XP/gold boost and a cosmetic-only reward exchanged for event tokens from monsters. Not for beta.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Event items must stay cosmetic. No power sold.

lessons.lesson: Do not adopt paid drop-rate or boss-spawn gamepasses, or gacha cards with a 2% chance.
lessons.source: 6Mo0ZJyRnQM storyboard_L3_00/09 GamePass ('Drop Rate x2', 'Spawn Summer Boss'); Soul RPG storyboard_06 caption
lessons.quote: 2% 확률로 뽑을 수 있는 신성 카드인데
lessons.status_evidence: The only products are class and faction change tickets (Config.luau:1019-1022).
lessons.suggestion: Keep monetization to convenience and cosmetics without power. Record this as a rejected pattern.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Decision 5 forbids stat monetization, and the audience is kids and teens. Paid drop rate and gacha power are not allowed.

lessons.lesson: A weapon ladder works as a level roadmap: in the guide, crafting through to the katana covers Lv1-30. We have no defined weapon goal after tier 3.
lessons.quote: 그리고 재료 모아서 카타나 만들면 30렙까지는 끝입니다
lessons.status_evidence: Weapons exist for tiers 1-7, with MinLevel 1/1/5/12/20/30/40 (Config.luau:155-162), but the shop sells only up to tier 3 (Config.luau:153, MaxSoldTier=3). Tiers 4+ have no source, and decision 5 routes rare and top items to drops, hard quests and boss crafting, none of which is implemented.
lessons.suggestion: Write a one-page ladder: which level band uses which weapon, and where tier 4+ comes from (rare drop, hard quest or boss material). Then surface it as the next goal, starting from Lv5 after iron.

lessons.lesson: Players get bored of pure hunting. A daily quest gives a reason to come back once a day, and side events break up the grind.
lessons.quote: 내가 지금 사냥만 하다가 너무 질려가지고 / 일일 퀘스트 있으면 그래도 하루에 한 번 씩은
lessons.status_evidence: The goose tug event (every 600s, Config.luau:629), kaiju, the bounty board (Config.luau:767) and dailies exist. There is no fishing or other non-combat activity.
lessons.suggestion: Make sure the first goose a new player meets is announced clearly, with how to join, since it is our break from hunting. Do not add fishing for beta. Dailies still unlock after the first goals (main-b-02).

lessons.lesson: A creator's first coverage judges bugs and balance harshly. Ship the first 10 minutes stable before inviting anyone.
lessons.source: Soul RPG UQ7zRWzcIgo storyboard_00/09/12 captions (creator's opinion)
lessons.quote: 밸런스도 아직 안 맞는 부분이 많고 / 버그도 진짜 엄청 많아가지고
lessons.status_evidence: RELEASE_PLAN has a feature freeze on 10/24 and reserves 10/25-10/30 for testing and bug fixes only. The 10-minute flow is not verified end to end; the current state was described as an uncommitted tree.
lessons.suggestion: Use a timed 10-minute playthrough with a fresh save and no debug gold as the release gate. Keep a short known-issues list before beta.

lessons.lesson: Prove the core loop by playing it before adding content (interview and solo-dev roadmap).
lessons.quote: 규모를 키우기 전 핵심 재미를 거친 프로토타입으로 확인하고 재미가 약하면 이 단계에서 다시 검토하라는 설명이다.
lessons.status_evidence: RELEASE_PLAN's '게임성을 먼저' ordering and the 10-minute milestone show this principle is adopted. Actual verification is pending (Studio work resumes 10/06).
lessons.suggestion: Before adding scrolls or auto mode, run and record the real 10-minute flow (faction, mission, reward, blacksmith, next goal) and fix the gaps found in main-b-01 to 06 first.

lessons.lesson: Scope guard: the reference games show fishing, seasonal shops, crafting, trade or auction, gamepasses, guilds, mounts, transcendence trees and 2nd/3rd class jobs. None of these are beta features.
lessons.source: §11 note line 631 and 6Mo0ZJyRnQM doc '가져오지 않을 것'; Soul RPG storyboards 04, 07-09
lessons.quote: 낚시·시즌 상점·제작·게임패스 등 새 기능을 베타에 추가하는 승인이 아니다.
lessons.status_evidence: None of these exist in src. RELEASE_PLAN places materials, crafting and the trade exchange after launch, except the newly confirmed boss-material crafting direction (weapon_progression doc).
lessons.suggestion: Keep these out of beta. Revisit trade or guilds only after launch.

lessons.lesson: In the first session, connect what the player wants (get stronger, help, plunder) to one readable next action and its outcome.
lessons.quote: 플레이어가 강해지기·도와주기·털기 중 현재 목적을 정했을 때 다음 행동과 그 결과를 알 수 있는지 검토한다.
lessons.status_evidence: The Halo 'Hunt' and Horns 'Plunder' quests need Lv15 (Config.luau:963, 981-984), and grudge-sack messages exist (Config.luau:1576-1600). Before Lv10 there is no help or plunder action that tilts the player toward Halo or Horns. Co-op kills share rewards but give no tilt (MonsterService.luau:1049-1066).
lessons.suggestion: Propose to the user one early faction-flavoured micro-goal per side that tilts under GDD §0. For example, Halo could earn a small Honor for helping someone finish a monster, and Horns could earn Infamy for grabbing a golden slime first. These are new rules and need approval.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: New reward or tilt rules need user approval. Do not invent them silently.

lessons.lesson: Keep the cost of failure consistent with the fun on offer. Early safe zones should cost nothing, and risk should appear only where faction conflict is the point.
lessons.source: §7.6 콤므 i6qaNzUWAcA (compilation transcript 10:40-19:14 matched to 4 frames)
lessons.quote: 현재 핵심인 쉬운 조작과 천사/악마 쪽 선택의 결과를 기준으로 HUD·보상·실패 부담이 같은 방향을 향하는지 검토한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Carried gold auto-banks in towns (ProgressionService.luau:265-277). SlimeMeadow is safe (Config.luau:731-733), and plunder applies only in PvP zones at Lv10+. A bully victim gets '잃은 건 없어요' (Config.luau:1590).
lessons.suggestion: Verify that the HUD shows carried gold at risk when entering a PvP zone. Keep Lv1-10 loss-free.

lessons.lesson: Chunk dialogue text: smaller units read slower and larger ones faster. Keep the guide's lines short and skippable.
lessons.quote: 내용을 더 작은 단위로 나누면 진행 속도가 느려지고 큰 단위로 제시하면 빨라질 수 있다는 균형을 설명한다.
lessons.status_evidence: The Welcome dialogue has 3 lines per faction, some of them two sentences long (Config.luau:919-944). It auto-opens after the class pick (QuestService.luau:329-366).
lessons.suggestion: Check reading time on phone. Make each line 1-2 short sentences, with tap-to-advance and a visible '수락' that starts the mission immediately.

lessons.lesson: Depth options for manual combat seen in the references, a mana-cost dash and a parry, are possible later layers.
lessons.source: 코대 guide storyboard_00 captions; Soul RPG storyboard_03 caption
lessons.quote: 일단 q를 누르면 대시가 가능합니다 / 패링을 할 수가 있어요
lessons.status_evidence: The only skill is the basic MP20/3s skill (HUD.luau:2634-2641; RELEASE_PLAN). There is no dash or parry.
lessons.suggestion: Do not add these for beta. After launch, consider one mobility skill bought from the skill shop (decision 5: basic skills are sold in shops).

lessons.lesson: Listen to beta feedback as 'feeling', and measure PvP win rate and how annoying it is to be the victim. This is policy taken from RELEASE_PLAN, because the patch video itself is unsummarisable.
lessons.source: §7.3 콤므 7vlaKjH2OZE (3 frames only) and note line 368
lessons.quote: 이미 `RELEASE_PLAN.md`에 확정된 “유저 말은 느낌으로 듣고 승률과 당할 때의 불쾌함을 함께 본다”는 방침을 유지하며
lessons.status_evidence: There is no analytics or telemetry in src (grep for AnalyticsService/LogCustomEvent finds nothing).
lessons.suggestion: Before beta, log a few server events: plunder success/fail, sack returned, time to first mission done, time to blacksmith, first weapon bought. Use Roblox AnalyticsService custom events with no personal data.

lessons.lesson: Both reference RPGs keep one pinned guide quest on screen that always names the next objective long after the first hunt (Untitled: a guide-quest tracker reading a 'reach Lv 35' goal with a progress bar on a Lv-35 demo character, in every tile; Soul RPG: an NPC-given guide quest with guide text at the top). The first reward must flow straight into the next goal.
lessons.source: Untitled guide GV5zZLF-nD8 guide_storyboard_00-14 (tracker top-left; crop of 04 r2c2 ~3:20); Soul RPG UQ7zRWzcIgo storyboard_04 r3c2-r3c3 (~3:35-3:40); note game_reference_untitled_rpg §3
lessons.quote: 첫 보상을 받은 뒤 다음 목표·필요 골드·다음 지역을 스스로 찾는지 검사.
lessons.status_evidence: QuestService.luau:410-416 tutorialEntry returns nil once BlacksmithVisited is true, so the pinned '안내' row vanishes; HUD.luau:1908-1910 the upgrade card is static ('장비 상인 / 무기 선택 · 구매 · 판매'); no further main objective exists (matches user-reported state).
lessons.suggestion: Extend the existing pinned Tutorial entry into a short main chain after the blacksmith visit: one action per step, each with progress, reward and the existing HUD.ShowGuide beam. Example steps: reach Lv5 → choose iron weapon at blacksmith OR keep hunting (purchase optional) → challenge 왕 슬라임 → Lv10 고블린 숲 (PvP warning). Targets/rewards are the user's numbers; never point at unimplemented scrolls/rare items.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: A22 removed '다음 해금' previews; a step naming the current objective (next weapon/zone) is not an unlock teaser, but confirm wording with the user. Must stay non-forcing per GDD §0-1.

lessons.lesson: The user's Lv.1 Untitled screenshot shows exactly one quest ('첫 사냥', 10 goblins, 0/10) with nothing competing. A new player should see one objective until the first mission is claimed. Ours shows three dailies from minute 0, and each daily pays more than the guided first mission, diluting the first reward.
lessons.quote: 왼쪽에 **첫 사냥**, 고블린 10마리 처치, **0/10** 진행이 보인다. | 처음 할 행동 하나와 남은 양을 가까이 표시한다.
lessons.status_evidence: Config.luau:916 QuestRewardGold=120; Config.luau:990 Daily.QuestMinutes=5 → HuntValue(1,5)=60 kills×3g=180g+300XP per daily; HUD.luau:129 '오늘의 퀘스트 (%d/%d)' renders dailies beside the pinned row from join.
lessons.suggestion: Hide/lock the daily slots (or the daily header) until TutorialStep reaches 99 (first mission claimed), then reveal them with a one-line toast as a new feature moment. Alternatively make the first mission reward feel at least as big as a daily. Exact numbers: ask user.

lessons.lesson: Reference shop flow goes sign/NPC → item list with price and owned currency → purchase result in one place. Our potion slot can never be refilled, which matters more now that the skill costs MP20 and the planned auto mode will cast skills.
lessons.source: 6Mo0ZJyRnQM storyboard_L3_04 r2c2 → L3_05 r1c1 (~3:20-3:45); UQ7zRWzcIgo storyboard_10 r1c2 (~7:35); notes video_reference_6Mo0 table, video_reference_notes §10
lessons.quote: 베타 3: 현재 빠진 구매 화면·요청 경로, 재고 0개의 무반응, 상인 비활성인데 접근하라는 안내를 함께 해결.
lessons.status_evidence: ShopService.luau:204-268 server CanBuyPotions/BuyPotion exist; Config.luau:33 MerchantEnabled=false; ShopService.luau:235 fires OpenPanel 'PotionShop' but Panels.luau BUILDERS has no PotionShop (only Nickname/Welcome/Menu/Travel/Rebirth/Altar/Class/WeaponShop/Shop/Vacation); VitalsUI.luau:47,56-61 at 0 stock the slot reads '구매' and pressing does nothing; Config.luau:34 PotionMerchantTemplate='Costume_HaloWarriorM' (chibi costume rig).
lessons.suggestion: Spawn the merchant as a temporary default Roblox-style NPC (decision 3) and enable it. Build a PotionShop panel inside the existing approved panel frame: price, held gold (reuse WeaponGoldF bank+carried line), stock/cap 99, buy ×1/×5, server-result toast. Make the 0-stock '구매' tap show the guide beam/travel to the merchant. Test deduction, not-enough-gold reason, cap, rapid taps.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Config comment says enable only after the user picks the GPT potion-shop preview; GPT is cancelled and new art needs Firefly + approval. Using a default Roblox NPC and the existing panel style needs a quick user OK; do not invent new styling.

lessons.lesson: An early Untitled quest sends the player to the pawn shop to sell exactly 10 goblin drops (keeping the rest for crafting): quests introduce each town service once, by doing it.
lessons.source: Untitled guide_storyboard_04 r3c3 → 05 r1c3 (~3:40-3:55), baked captions paraphrased
lessons.quote: [frame, paraphrased] Caption: you then get a quest to sell goblin blood; go to the pawn shop and sell only 10, since the rest is needed later for weapon crafting.
lessons.status_evidence: QuestService.luau:410-412 only the blacksmith is introduced (Config.Tutorial.Text.VisitBlacksmith '무기 살펴보기 · 교차로 마을 대장간'), visit-only; no potion step (merchant disabled).
lessons.suggestion: Once the merchant works, add one chain step '물약 상인에게서 HP 물약 사기' with the guide beam; introduce other services (pads, altar) only when they become relevant. One service per step.

lessons.lesson: Untitled town buildings carry their function name above the door (pawn shop, enhancement, crafting, weapon workshop), so services are findable without a guide.
lessons.source: Untitled guide_storyboard_00 r3c3 → 01 r3c3 (~0:40-1:20); note game_reference §2
lessons.quote: 마을 건물에 기능 이름이 붙고, NPC 가까이에서 상호작용 표시와 판매·조합 화면을 연다.
lessons.status_evidence: ShopService.luau:162 anvil ProximityPrompt '무기 보기 / 마을 대장간' is only visible up close; MapBuilder.luau:652/756 billboards exist for 운명의 제단 and 황금 거위 둥지 but none for blacksmith or potion merchant; HUD guide beam to anvil only until BlacksmithVisited (HUD.luau:2559-2567).
lessons.suggestion: Add plain billboard labels '대장간' / '물약 상점' above those NPCs using the same MapBuilder billboard() helper/style as the altar sign (no new art). Test: a new player finds both from the plaza without the beam.

lessons.lesson: Shop and crafting panels in both games list each item's stat lines next to its price, so a purchase is an informed choice.
lessons.source: UQ7 storyboard_10 r1c2 (~7:35) weapon-shop rows with stat lines; Untitled guide_storyboard_02 r2c2, 07 r2c1-r2c2, 13 r1c3 crafting windows (stat text unreadable at 320x180)
lessons.quote: [frame, paraphrased] Weapon-shop/crafting entries show several stat lines under each item name beside the price/craft button.
lessons.status_evidence: Panels.luau:150-181 weapon texts cover price, need level, held gold, shortfall, owned/equipped; no WeaponDamage/공격력 in Panels.luau (grep); Config.WeaponDamage(tier, level) exists.
lessons.suggestion: Add one line per weapon in the existing panel, e.g. '공격 8 → 15 (+88%)' from Config.WeaponDamage × class Damage, optionally '슬라임 N방'. Text only.

lessons.lesson: Both games place training dummies with live Total/DPS counters in town (Untitled sign: 훈련장, 'find out what your item can do'), letting players feel a new weapon instantly.
lessons.source: user_hud_reference.png center (훈련장 sign + dummies with Total/DPS); UQ7 storyboard_02 r3c1 (~2:00), storyboard_06 r2c1 (~4:45)
lessons.quote: [frame, paraphrased] Training ground sign tells players to test their item's power; dummies display Total and DPS counters.
lessons.status_evidence: No 'Dummy' anywhere in src (grep).
lessons.suggestion: Place 1–2 dummies beside the blacksmith anvil: safe zone, no gold/XP/quest credit, per-hit numbers + 10-s DPS readout. Model = temporary default Roblox rig (user OK needed). Lets the player compare old vs new weapon right after buying, and later enhancement.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Any custom dummy art would need Firefly + approval; use a default Roblox rig only.

lessons.lesson: The Untitled guide tells beginners not to enhance early, because early weapons get replaced quickly and the enhancement is wasted.
lessons.quote: [frame, paraphrased] Caption: early on you keep switching weapons, so skip enhancing at the start.
lessons.status_evidence: GDD §0-1: scroll enhancement not implemented; ShopService sells tiers 2/3 (150/800g) and buys back at 1/10; no enhancement field in Config/DataService.
lessons.suggestion: Before building scroll enhancement, get one rule from the user: when the player buys/switches weapons, does the enhancement level carry over, are scrolls refunded on sale, or do scrolls start dropping only where weapon swaps slow down? Recommend carry-over or refund so early scrolls never feel wasted. No numbers invented; no failure/destruction.

lessons.lesson: Untitled's rare crafting core drops about 1% from normal goblins vs about 10% from armored (elite) goblins, so elites are worth seeking out.
lessons.source: Untitled guide_storyboard_07 r2c3 → r3c1 (~5:40-5:45) baked caption
lessons.quote: [frame, paraphrased] Caption: cores drop at about 1% from normal and 10% from armored goblins.
lessons.status_evidence: Config.luau:860 GoldenChance=0.04 (golden = 10× gold, 3× XP via MonsterService killRecord); BigSlime/GoblinBrute/SkeletonKnight are stat bumps only; no item drops exist.
lessons.suggestion: When scroll drops are added, make elites (왕 슬라임 etc.) and golden monsters the clearly better scroll source, with server-side rolls. The user picks the numbers.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Drop numbers are explicitly undecided by the user; do not set them.

lessons.lesson: Loot shows up as a pickup line ('+ ×1 item') and bosses show a reward list. Soul RPG's in-game codex tells where each item is used, so players need no wiki.
lessons.source: 6Mo0 storyboard_L3_08 r1c1 (~6:00), L3_05 r3c3 (~4:25), L3_09 r3c3 (~7:25); UQ7 storyboard_01 r3c1 → 02 r1c2 (~1:15-1:35), storyboard_10 r3c3 (~8:10); note video_reference_notes §10
lessons.quote: 목록을 고르면 오른쪽 상세 정보가 바뀌는 도감 화면. ... 새 도감 시스템을 출시 조건으로 추가하지 않는다.
lessons.status_evidence: Fx.luau:3377-3398 handlers.Reward shows '+N G' / '+N XP' floating numbers and a golden burst: gold/XP only; no item pickup feed or item explanation exists.
lessons.suggestion: For the first scroll drop: pickup popup '강화 주문서 +1', a HUD count, and a one-time line saying what it is for and where to use it ('대장간에서 지금 무기를 강화해요') plus the guide beam. No codex.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Notes forbid adding a 도감 as a release condition; a one-time tooltip only.

lessons.lesson: Soul RPG's enhancement panel shows '+0 / +50', the stat block and a single 강화하기 button; extra items raise the cap.
lessons.quote: [frame, paraphrased] Enhancement window shows current/max level, stat lines and one enhance button; caption mentions unlocking the enhancement limit with a core item.
lessons.status_evidence: No enhancement UI or data in src.
lessons.suggestion: Our scroll enhancement UI: current +N / max, exact stat gain of the next step, scrolls owned/needed, one button, always succeeds. Cap-raising rare items only if the user wants that role for rare drops.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Success rate in Soul RPG is unknown; do not import any failure/destruction (user rule). Schedule of scrolls for beta is not confirmed — if not in beta, treat as launch.

lessons.lesson: All three videos show the area name on screen when the player enters a region; Untitled adds a description and a green recommended-level line.
lessons.source: Untitled guide_storyboard_04 r2c2 (~3:20), 08 r2c3, 10 r2c2/r3c2; UQ7 storyboard_11 r3c2 (~8:50); 6Mo0 storyboard_L3_05 r1c2 (~3:50); notes game_reference §2, video_reference_notes §10
lessons.quote: 초원에서 연못을 지나 사막으로 이동하며 지역명이 표시된다.
lessons.status_evidence: MapBuilder.luau:216-226 gateSignText puts 'name Lv N+ PvP/안전 + lore' on world gate arches; ZoneService.luau:327-336 only toasts EnteredPvP/EnteredSafe on PvP boundary changes; no on-screen zone-name banner on ZoneChanged.
lessons.suggestion: On the client ZoneId attribute change, show a 2–3 s top-center line such as '말랑 초원 · Lv 1+ · 안전 지역' with existing Announce/Toast styling, reusing the gate-sign content. Most important when entering PvP 고블린 숲.

lessons.lesson: Reference HUDs group Lv → EXP → large HP/MP numbers in one block and keep the screen center free. The notes ask us to check our approved HUD on phones rather than copy their layout.
lessons.source: user_hud_reference.png; 6Mo0 storyboard_L3_04 r1c1 (~3:00, enlarged HUD); notes game_reference §3/§5, video_reference_6Mo0 table
lessons.quote: **베타 4:** HP·MP·골드·물약 수량은 전투 중 계속 읽히고, 자세한 메뉴를 열어도 현재 상황을 잃지 않게 검사한다.
lessons.status_evidence: HUD.luau:2806-2836 stacks player card (Lv/XP/HP/MP/gold), potions and quest list top-left; war meter top-center; attack/skill bottom-right; L.StickZoneX keeps bottom-left clear on touch; phone readability not yet verified (A22 검증 경계).
lessons.suggestion: Keep the approved layout. Check on phone-size screens: card+potion+quest stack height, number truncation, overlap with jump/attack. When the auto toggle returns, put it in the existing square row (L.Square already sized for '자동') instead of a new block.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Do not copy the reference minimap, empty skill slots or bottom-center layout; approved HUD art stays.

lessons.lesson: Both games put consumables in 1/2/3 quick slots with counts beside the vitals; Untitled makes players register items to the quickbar, which its guide has to explain.
lessons.source: 6Mo0 storyboard_L3_04 r1c1 (~3:00); Untitled guide_storyboard_03 r1c2 → r2c1 (~2:15-2:25); user_hud_reference.png slots 1/2/3
lessons.quote: [frame, paraphrased] Caption: open the bag, pick the item and register it to the quickbar.
lessons.status_evidence: VitalsUI.luau:109-136 fixed HP/MP potion buttons with count + status; keys 1/2 at VitalsUI.luau:214-215.
lessons.suggestion: Keep fixed slots (no registration step for beginners). Only verify touch size and that the 0-stock state guides to the merchant.

lessons.lesson: Soul RPG's weapon shop shows owned currency in its header next to the purchase list.
lessons.quote: 무기 상점에 보유 재화와 구매 항목이 한 화면에 있다.
lessons.status_evidence: Panels.luau:157-158 'WeaponGoldF 보유 %s골드 (금고 %s + 주머니 %s)' and 'WeaponShortF %s골드가 더 필요해요.'
lessons.suggestion: Reuse the same held-gold and shortfall lines in the potion panel.

lessons.lesson: 6Mo0 shows a separate yes/cancel confirm before an expensive limited event item; the note says not to make confirms a mandatory step.
lessons.quote: 영상의 확인창을 새 필수 단계로 추가하자는 뜻은 아니다.
lessons.status_evidence: Panels.luau:170-172 confirm dialog only for selling (WeaponSellConfirmF); buying is one press with a server result.
lessons.suggestion: Keep: no confirm for potions or cheap buys, confirm only for irreversible actions (persona: fewer repeated confirmations).

lessons.lesson: Untitled marks elite and skill attacks with red ground areas, yet its guide complains hits still register after you dodge: the warning and the damage must match. 6Mo0 also shows a red skill radius on the ground.
lessons.source: Untitled guide_storyboard_06 r1c1-r1c3 (~4:30-4:40), 13 r3c2 → 14 r1c2 (~10:20-10:35); 6Mo0 storyboard_L3_05 r1c2 (~3:50); note game_reference §2
lessons.quote: 적 앞 바닥에 붉은 공격 영역과 공격 효과가 보인다.
lessons.status_evidence: Config.luau:1673 monster MonsterWindup 0.28 s pose telegraph, WindupLeeway 2 (hit lands within AttackRange 5.5+2); KaijuService.luau:440-462 stomp damages Halo players in StompRadius first, then sends the 'Stomp' Fx ring (Fx.luau:3512) — no warning before damage.
lessons.suggestion: Kaiju stomp (and any future elite AoE): send a ground warning ring first (duration to tune, e.g. under 1 s), then damage only players still inside the drawn radius at impact. Basic mobs: keep the short windup but verify on phone that stepping away during it avoids the hit.

lessons.lesson: Untitled gives each new zone a new monster trait (slow, damage-over-time curse, dash, knock-up), and its armored goblin 'uses skills like a boss', so players learn something new per zone.
lessons.quote: [frame, paraphrased] Captions: from the desert on monsters gain special traits (slow, curse, dash); the armored goblin acts like a boss and uses skills.
lessons.status_evidence: Config.luau:880-888 MonsterTypes differ only in HP/Damage/Speed/Scale; all share one melee attack (Config.Monsters AttackRange 5.5).
lessons.suggestion: Give 왕 슬라임 one readable telegraphed move (e.g. jump-slam with a warning ring) so the first 10 minutes contain a 'harder challenge' after the weapon choice. Later, one trait per zone. Use existing Fx ring code, no new art.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Only the 왕 슬라임 move fits beta; other zone traits are launch scope (10/24 feature freeze).

lessons.lesson: The Untitled guide warns goblin hitboxes are tiny and you must swing slightly ahead of monsters; precise melee hitboxes frustrate beginners.
lessons.quote: [frame, paraphrased] Captions: goblins have very small hitboxes; when attacking, aim slightly in front.
lessons.status_evidence: Config.luau:215-270 class Patterns auto-pick targets per press (Warrior Around 10 studs, Mage nearest within 35 + splash 7, Archer 2 nearest within 30): no aiming needed.
lessons.suggestion: Keep auto-target per press. On phone, verify a press with nothing in range gives clear feedback instead of silence, and that the nearest monster is chosen.

lessons.lesson: 6Mo0's fishing minigame clearly separates 'press now' and 'success' states. The note maps this to the old timing release, which no longer exists; the remaining lesson is distinct ready/not-ready/result states for the MP skill.
lessons.source: 6Mo0 storyboard_L3_07 r1c2 → r2c2 (~5:20-5:35); note video_reference_6Mo0 table

lessons.lesson: No auto-battle toggle appears in any reviewed tile of the three videos (the right-side squares are E/R/T skill slots), and the Untitled guide says that game blocks macros. If we add auto, it needs anti-AFK guardrails.

lessons.suggestion: Implement the user's toggle (starts OFF, unlocked by the optional quest, basic attacks + skills vs monsters only) with guardrails. (1) Auto pauses after N minutes without real input/movement and asks to resume. (2) Auto never targets players, and goose/kaiju/war rewards keep requiring manual hits. (3) Auto turns off in towns and on death. (4) Server enforces MP/cooldown for auto skills. N is the user's call.
lessons.conflict_with_decisions: Untitled forbids macros entirely; that is not a reason to drop the user's auto decision, only to add AFK limits. The legacy Lv5 auto unlock (A3/A7) is replaced by the optional-quest unlock.

lessons.lesson: Untitled ties capability unlocks to specific quests (clearing the magma-golem quest grants a strong skill that players then always equip), making the reward named and memorable.

lessons.suggestion: Offer the optional quest right after faction choice as a separate row with a '선택' badge (not the pinned main chain), stating the reward plainly ('완료하면 자동 사냥 ON/OFF 사용 가능'), with a short manual task. On claim, reveal the toggle in the existing 자동 square, OFF by default; save the unlock. Keep the first mission as the highlighted objective.

Config.Tutorial (Config.luau 904-953) covers the unit:

- enemy and count: QuestText "보급로 되찾기 · 슬라임 %d마리" with QuestKills=5.
- reward: QuestRewardGold=120, shown in QuestStart and on the pinned row (QuestService tutorialEntry 393-420 sets RewardGold).

The 'next where' link stops after the blacksmith (see tutorials-02).

lessons.lesson: After the first reward, keep showing what the reward is for. If the player cannot afford the next weapon yet, show how much is missing instead of implying they can buy it.
lessons.source: docs/art/tutorial_openings_2026-10-04_roblox_research.md §3 proposal 2; Fisch row in tutorial_openings_2026-10-04.md; onboarding_story_review §2 item 4
lessons.quote: 보유 골드가150 미만이면 즉시 살 수 있다고 약속하지 않는다.
lessons.status_evidence:
- After the claim, the pinned row reads Text.VisitBlacksmith "무기 살펴보기 · 교차로 마을 대장간".
- QuestService tutorialEntry (lines 409-414) returns nil once data.BlacksmithVisited is true. ShopService sets that flag on the anvil prompt, even if the player buys nothing, so the guide row simply disappears.

- Minimum path: Slime Gold=3 (Config 881), 5 kills plus 120 = 135 gold, against Tier 2 Price=150 (Config 157), starting BankGold 0. Horns get +25% kill gold; weaker-faction picks get SignOnGold 300.

Reuse the existing pinned 안내 row (text only, no new UI) and have it read real state after the claim:
1. Gold below the next tier price: '나무 검까지 N골드 · 말랑 초원 사냥'.

Do not end the row on BlacksmithVisited alone. Keep the purchase a choice, as the HUD comment 'The shop is a choice' intends.

lessons.lesson: Pin the current objective from the very first step (dialog, then travel, then hunt) so a player who missed a toast still knows what to do.

Closing still must never accept. Text-only, reusing the existing buttons. Re-measure whether the line text fits at font size 22 on a phone.
